verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is built as an agentic assistant that can be delegated coding, debugging, automation, and PR/issue tasks (gemini-cli-gh-3/4/10/11/12), and some users praise its huge context window for large-codebase delegation (gemini-cli-comm-1, gemini-cli-comm-12). However, multiple hands-on reports describe it as unreliable for agentic work—getting stuck in error loops, ignoring context files, catastrophic file-deletion incidents, and being 'terrible at agentic stuff' compared to competitors (gemini-cli-comm-10, gemini-cli-comm-11, gemini-cli-comm-13, gemini-cli-comm-14, gemini-cli-comm-16).
